def chunk_into_n_parts(lst, n):
    length = len(lst)
    base, extra = divmod(length, n)
    parts = []
    pos = 0
    for i in range(n):
        size = base + (1 if i < extra else 0)
        parts.append(lst[pos:pos + size])
        pos += size
    return parts
